segments.text: Espec, a motion detection system that sees movement using Wi-Fi waves, not cameras or microphones. It runs on a
simple ESP32S3 board, costs about €10, and plugs right into Home Assistant or MQTT. No AI models here. Especal
analysis to detect motion in real time by reading Wi-Fi channel data. It works through walls, protects your privacy, and turns any smart home into a motion
system. No wearables, no training, just clever physics.
